Request Time Off (with calendar)

User manual · English · 12 steps
Learn how to submit a time off request: choose the leave type, give a reason, pick your dates in the calendar, save the request, and check that it is waiting for your manager.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. New request

Click New to start a time off request.

3. Time Off Type

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

4. Choose the type

Click the result you want in the list.

5. Reason

Type a short reason for your request, then press Tab.

6. Open the calendar

Click the date field to open the calendar.

7. Pick your last day

Click the last day of your leave in the calendar.

8. Apply

Click Apply to confirm your dates.

9. Save & Close

Click Save & Close to submit your request.

10. My Time

Open the My Time menu to check your request.

11. My Time Off

Open My Time Off.

12. Check the status

Your new request is at the top. Click the status to finish.
